title: Audio Classification — From k-NN on MFCCs to AST and BEATs
service: ClipTag: pooled-MFCC audio tagging with a SQLite clip bank and k-NN

parts.lesson_anchor: Build It, Steps 1-2: featurize and mean+var summary
planted_bugs: frame_signal emits a partial frame for clips shorter than one frame; the IndexError surfaces two calls later in apply_filterbank
summarize indexes frames[0] before checking for an empty clip
summarize divides by t-1 although the docstring and lesson use the population variance
summarize recomputes the mean inside the variance loop, O(T^2 n)
parts.timing_assert: 3000x13 frames under 0.2 s (quadratic version takes about 2 s)
parts.overfix_guard: variance stays accurate with a 1e8 offset, which rules out the one-pass E[x^2]-E[x]^2 shortcut

parts.exactness: features round-trip bit-for-bit as a list, across close and reopen
traps: CREATE TABLE without IF NOT EXISTS
CHECK constraint raises IntegrityError, not ValueError

parts.lesson_anchor: Step 3 k-NN; Class imbalance; Evaluation (per-class recall, macro F1)
traps: macro F1 skipping the never-predicted class
clarifying_questions: k larger than the train set

parts.lesson_anchor: real-time / edge use of the classifier; windowed analysis
parts.wire_format: NDJSON, one object per window, decided by the test's join/splitlines/json.loads

traps: children as dict, list, or list containing dicts
parent keeps its own higher score
